title: CVDI Human Disease Portal (Private Results V2)
bodyHtml:
1. Set Ancestry and Cohort.
  2. Search a gene to get a list of phenotypes associated with the gene.
  3. Click 'Search' button.
  4. To load Phenotype Associations data, hover on the phenotype under 'Phenotype' column in the loaded phenotypes list table and click 'Search Phenotype'.
  5. Full list of phenotypes available under "Phenotypes Full List" tab.
